summary: Join Gender and Human Rights Training Course to gain essential skills and knowledge. Advocate for equality and justice in your personal and professional life.
lede: Rights-based gender analysis helps organizations assess policies and operations for human rights impacts. Designed for compliance, policy and social-impact professionals, the course covers GBA+ assessments, human rights due diligence and risk prioritization, drafting gender-responsive policies, and designing prevention and response processes for workplace harassment and gender-based violence.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals tasked with translating human rights commitments into operational reality. The curriculum speaks directly to those managing compliance, policy design, and social impact within complex organizational structures.
audience: Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) Advisors
outcomes: Supply Chain Human Rights Risk Assessment
modules: International Human Rights and Gender Frameworks
Digital Rights, AI Bias, and Technology
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of organizational policy, compliance, or social impact initiatives. Prior exposure to basic human rights concepts or diversity programs is recommended. No advanced legal background or data science coding experience is required, as all analytical frameworks and assessment templates will be provided during the course.
